auth_meta_login_description: Sign in to SOTF Mods to follow mods, get pinged when they update and publish your own.
auth_meta_register_description: Join SOTF Mods: stash mods in your backpack, get pinged when they update and share your own creations.
auth_meta_forgot_description: Forgot your SOTF Mods password? We’ll email you a link to choose a new one.
auth_meta_reset_description: Choose a new password for your SOTF Mods account.
auth_meta_verify_description: Confirm the email address of your SOTF Mods account.
auth_meta_logout_description: Sign out of SOTF Mods on this device.
auth_art_tagline: Day 1 on the island starts here.
auth_noscript: Signing in needs JavaScript. Turn it on for this site and reload the page.
auth_field_remember: Keep me signed in on this device
auth_field_display_name_hint: How other survivors see you. You can change it later.
auth_field_handle_hint: Your address on the island: {url}. It can’t be changed later.
auth_field_email_hint: For signing in and important account emails. Never shown publicly.
auth_field_new_password_hint: At least 10 characters. A few random words work great.
auth_field_terms: I accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.
auth_error_handle_format: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens, not at the start or end.
auth_error_handle_reserved: That handle is reserved. Pick another one.
auth_error_handle_taken: That handle is taken. Try another one.
auth_error_email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in or reset your password.
auth_error_email_disposable: Disposable email addresses can’t be used. Use an address you’ll keep.
auth_error_already_registered: This email or handle is already registered.
auth_error_password_breached: This password appeared in a data breach. Choose a different one.
auth_error_terms: Accept the terms to create your account.
auth_error_invalid_value: This value can’t be used. Check it and try again.
auth_error_turnstile_failed: The security check didn’t finish. Check your connection or allow challenges.cloudflare.com in your blocker, then try again.
auth_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait {seconds, number} s and try again.
auth_login_legacy_note: Had an account before the rebuild? Your password still works.
auth_login_turnstile_hint: Complete the quick security check below, then sign in again.
auth_login_already_sign_out: Sign out and use another account
auth_flag_registered: Account created. Sign in to continue.
auth_flag_reset: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
auth_flag_verified: Email verified. Sign in to continue.
auth_flag_expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
auth_welcome_verify: We sent a verification link to {email}. Open it to start commenting, reviewing and uploading.
auth_welcome_resent: Sent. Check your inbox and your spam folder.
auth_onboarding_language_text: Pick the language for the site and your emails.
auth_onboarding_theme_text: Night is easy on the eyes after dark; Day reads best in sunlight.
auth_onboarding_follow_text: Following a mod pings you as soon as it updates.
auth_forgot_intro: Enter the email of your account and we’ll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth_forgot_sent_text: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It works for 60 minutes.
auth_forgot_sent_spam: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder or try again.
auth_reset_intro: Saving it signs you out everywhere; then sign in with the new password.
auth_reset_invalid_text: Reset links work once and expire after 60 minutes. Ask for a new one.
auth_verify_done_text: Your address is confirmed. You’re all set to comment, review and upload.
auth_verify_invalid_text: Verification links work once and expire after 24 hours. Ask for a new one.
auth_verify_sign_in_to_resend: Sign in to get a new link
auth_logout_text: Another site sent you here. Confirm to sign out of SOTF Mods on this device.
auth_menu_unverified: Verify your email to comment, review and upload.
auth_menu_resend_failed: Couldn’t send it. Try again in a moment.
auth_login_passkey_failed: The passkey sign-in was cancelled or no passkey is available on this device.
auth_twofactor_text: Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
auth_twofactor_hint: The 6-digit code from your app, or one of your recovery codes.
auth_twofactor_expired: This step expired. Sign in again to get a new one.
auth_twofactor_wrong: That code is not correct. Try again.
